# tebibcloud_images (Data Source)

The operating system images VMs can be created from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tebibcloud_images" "ubuntu" {
  os_family = "ubuntu"
}

output "ubuntu_images" {
  value = data.tebibcloud_images.ubuntu.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `os_family` (String) Only images of this family, e.g. `ubuntu`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Default: the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) The images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `names` (List of String) Image names, for `tebibcloud_vm.image`.

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `default_user` (String) User that gets the VM's SSH keys.
- `display_name` (String) Human name, e.g. `Ubuntu 24.04 LTS`.
- `distro` (String) Distribution code, e.g. `ubuntu`.
- `distro_name` (String) Distribution name, e.g. `Ubuntu`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the default image of its distribution.
- `min_disk_gib` (Number) Smallest boot volume.
- `min_memory_mib` (Number) Least memory.
- `min_vcpus` (Number) Fewest vCPUs.
- `name` (String) Name, for `tebibcloud_vm.image`.
- `os_family` (String) OS family.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position in the console's image list (lower first).
- `version` (String) Distribution version, e.g. `24.04`.
